messages:
alex: Quick check — there's a last-minute telemetry fix that needs to go in before cutoff (≈3h). If we accept, we need a version bump + one-line changelog. Can we decide? @maria @sam @li

maria: Can you paste the changelog line here? Is it user-visible or infra-only?

alex: Infra-only. Suggested changelog:

```
- Fix: correct telemetry tagging for request latency to improve SLO accuracy (infra)
```

Also gated behind a feature flag.

sam: CI shows a flaky telemetry integration test on one macOS job — failing intermittently. Not core, but flagging: https://ci.example/1234 :eyes:

li: I'm +1 if it's behind a flag and we have a rollout plan. Ops: any impact on alerting? @jen

jen: Ops note — if merged now we should suppress the latency alert for ~30m during rollout. I can do that but prefer to do it in hour 2 of the window. If folks want, we can slip to the next window instead.

alex: We'd like to keep it in this window. Can someone approve the manual gate? @release-bot can you unlock the late-change gate for the release window starting in ~3h?

release-bot: release-bot: Late change request received for release window starting at 2050129056. Policy: requires 2 ENG lead approvals + Ops ack. Approvals so far: none. To approve, react with :thumbsup: or reply `approve`.

maria: approve

sam: approve — but add the changelog line and note the flaky test in the PR description.

li: approve. I'll keep monitoring CI and be ready to rollback if anything looks off.

jen: ack — I'll schedule the alert suppression and coordinate with SRE. We'll post a short note in #announcements once canary is green. ETA: if canary passes, announcement in ~3.5h; otherwise we'll post a slip notice.

alex: Thanks — I'll update the PR with the changelog + CI note. Please :thumbsup: the PR when ready. I'll post an update here when canary passes.

sam: Pinged reviewers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789 :rocket:

alex: update: canary passed initial 10% fleet, no errors observed.

li: noted, monitoring dashboard: https://grafana/overview — latency tags look stable.

jen: Drafted announcement in #announcements: "Planned release proceeding; telemetry tag fix rolling out to 10% canary. No expected user impact." Waiting for final ok to post wide.

alex: final status — canary progressed to 50%, health OK. Go ahead and post to #announcements when you see 95% of checks passing. Thanks everyone.

release-bot: release-bot: Gate approved — 3 approvers recorded. Release window unlocked. Reminder: bump version to 0.9.5 and tag `release-0.9.5` after merge.
